---
title: "Alchemer account archive"
format:
  html:
    embed-resources: true
params:
  archive_dir: "alchemer_archive"
  min_age: 600
  refresh: "auto"
---

Keeps one `survey_<id>.rds` file per survey of the account in `archive_dir`,
with test data included, and records what happened to each survey. Only
read-only requests are sent. Credentials: set `ALCHEMER_API_TOKEN` and
`ALCHEMER_API_SECRET` (for example from `keyring` in your `.Renviron` or at the
top of this file). Copy this file with
`file.copy(system.file("quarto", "Archive_account.qmd", package = "alchemeR"), ".")`.

Audit trail: this page for the run, and `archive_log.csv` in `archive_dir`, which
gets one row per survey appended on every run.

```{r}
#| label: archive
library(alchemeR)
dir <- params$archive_dir
dir.create(dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
run_at <- Sys.time()

surveys <- all_surveys()
saveRDS(surveys, file.path(dir, "surveys.rds")) # the account list at run time

# Fetch one survey; keep its run message and its warnings instead of letting
# them scroll past, and turn an error into a row.
one <- function(id) {
  notes <- character()
  warns <- character()
  out <- tryCatch(
    withCallingHandlers(
      fetch_survey(id, dir = dir, refresh = params$refresh, min_age = params$min_age,
                   include_test = TRUE),
      message = \(m) {
        note <- trimws(conditionMessage(m))
        # httr2 shows each retry wait as a progress bar: one note is enough
        if (grepl("retry backoff", note)) note <- "retried after a server error"
        notes <<- union(notes, note)
        invokeRestart("muffleMessage")
      },
      warning = \(w) {
        warns <<- c(warns, conditionMessage(w))
        invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
      }
    ),
    error = \(e) e
  )
  failed <- inherits(out, "error")
  last <- if (length(notes) > 0) notes[length(notes)] else NA_character_
  data.frame(
    id = id,
    status = if (failed) "error" else if (length(warns) > 0) "warning" else "ok",
    rows = if (failed) NA_integer_ else nrow(out),
    latest_update = if (failed) as.POSIXct(NA) else attr(out, "alchemer")$max_date_updated,
    requests = suppressWarnings(as.integer(sub(".*, (\\d+) requests.*", "\\1", last))),
    action = paste(sub("^Survey \\d+: ", "", notes), collapse = " | "),
    problems = paste(c(if (failed) conditionMessage(out), warns), collapse = " | ")
  )
}
result <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(surveys$id, one))

files <- file.path(dir, paste0("survey_", result$id, ".rds"))
overview <- dplyr::tibble(
  result[c("id", "status")],
  title = surveys$title,
  result[c("rows", "latest_update", "requests")],
  # a failed survey keeps its old file, so its size would look like a success
  size_mb = ifelse(result$status == "error", NA, round(file.size(files) / 1e6, 2)),
  result[c("action", "problems")]
)

# One row per survey is appended on every run: a history across renders.
log_file <- file.path(dir, "archive_log.csv")
log_rows <- cbind(run_at = format(run_at, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z"), overview)
log_rows$latest_update <- format(log_rows$latest_update, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z")
log_rows[] <- lapply(log_rows, \(x) if (is.character(x)) gsub("[\r\n]+", " ", x) else x)
utils::write.table(
  log_rows, log_file, sep = ",", row.names = FALSE, qmethod = "double",
  append = file.exists(log_file), col.names = !file.exists(log_file)
)

orphans <- setdiff(
  sub("^survey_(\\d+)\\.rds$", "\\1", list.files(dir, "^survey_\\d+\\.rds$")),
  as.character(surveys$id)
)
```

## This run

```{r}
#| label: run-summary
#| echo: false
knitr::kable(data.frame(
  item = c("Run started", "alchemeR", "R", "archive_dir", "refresh", "min_age (s)",
           "Surveys on the account", "Requests sent"),
  value = c(format(run_at, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z"), as.character(packageVersion("alchemeR")),
            R.version.string, normalizePath(dir, winslash = "/"), params$refresh, params$min_age,
            nrow(surveys), sum(result$requests, na.rm = TRUE))
))
```

`r sum(overview$status == "ok")` surveys ok, `r sum(overview$status == "warning")` with
warnings, `r sum(overview$status == "error")` failed;
`r format(sum(overview$rows, na.rm = TRUE), big.mark = ",")` responses,
`r round(sum(overview$size_mb, na.rm = TRUE), 1)` MB.

## Failures and warnings

A survey with a warning was downloaded, but check the warning: for example answers
that could not be placed in a column, numbers set to `NA`, or a file that could
not be saved (the data is then in memory only and the file on disk is the old one).
Warnings arise while data is downloaded and parsed, so they show on the run that
downloaded the survey; a later run that only reads the file reports it as ok.
`archive_log.csv` keeps the earlier runs.

```{r}
#| label: issues
#| echo: false
issues <- overview[overview$status != "ok", c("id", "title", "status", "problems")]
if (nrow(issues) > 0) knitr::kable(issues) else cat("None.")
```

## All surveys

`latest_update` is the newest response change in the file (Toronto time); `action` is the
run message of `fetch_survey()`.

```{r}
#| label: all-surveys
#| echo: false
knitr::kable(overview[order(overview$id), names(overview) != "problems"])
```

## Files for surveys no longer on the account

```{r}
#| label: orphans
#| echo: false
if (length(orphans) > 0) cat(paste0("survey_", orphans, ".rds"), sep = "\n") else cat("None.")
```
